region.title: Fleet API region
region.description: Pick the region of your account, or Auto to detect it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: The Vehicle Fleet integration needs you to sign in again.

abort.reauth_account_mismatch: Signed in with a different account than the one being re-authenticated.
abort.invalid_token: The token returned by the sign-in could not be read.
abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles were found on this account.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.

init.title: Vehicle Fleet options
init.description: Polling never wakes the car: each poll first reads the vehicle state, and reads vehicle data (billed) only while the car is already online. Commands are off by default (read-only).

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Minimum 5. Each poll is one state read, plus one billed vehicle data read only when the car is online.
data_description.location: Adds a location tracker. The car shows a location-sharing indicator when location is read.
data_description.commands_enabled: Creates lock, climate, switch and button entities. Do not use them in automations.
data_description.proxy_url: Base URL of your tesla-http-proxy (https; plain http only on localhost). Required for commands.
data_description.proxy_ca_cert: Optional path to a CA certificate file that signed the proxy's TLS certificate.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid https URL without credentials, query or fragment.
error.http_not_loopback: Plain http is only allowed for a proxy on this machine (localhost).
error.proxy_required: A command proxy URL is required to enable commands.
error.ca_not_found: The CA certificate file was not found.

vehicle_not_online.message: The vehicle is {state}. Nothing was sent; press Wake first if you want to wake it.

commands_disabled.message: Commands are off (read-only mode). Turn them on in the integration options.

homelink_not_nearby.message: The vehicle reports no HomeLink device nearby. Nothing was sent.

homelink_no_location.message: No location is available for HomeLink. Nothing was sent.
